name: Phala Cloud
rootCause: A vulnerability in the Phala Cloud API endpoint allowed unauthorized modifications to some Offchain KMS CVMs. The attacker deployed a malicious pre-launch script to affected CVMs, which may have accessed decrypted environment variables after boot. The issue was identified, patched, and contained on June 1, 2026. Affected users/CVMs have been directly notified via email.
